summary: Add enti istat command for bidirectional IPA ↔ ISTAT lookup via CKAN open data.
reason: The IPA web services do not expose Codice_comune_ISTAT; it is only available in the CKAN datastore at indicepa.gov.it/ipa-dati. This command adds a new client (NewCKAN) and a new subcommand under enti that supports both directions: --codice <IPA> → ISTAT and --istat <ISTAT> → list of IPA entities.
validated_outcome: go build/vet pass. Live test: enti istat --codice c_g273 → Codice_comune_ISTAT 082053; enti istat --istat 082053 → 451 records.
